# About this package

`podcast-tool-short` is kubcode.dev's skill for turning a podcast segment about a
software tool into a short vertical clip: original speaker audio, reframed
visuals, Thai captions, an opening hook, and posting copy with credit to the
source episode. It is released under the MIT licence (see `LICENSE`).

## Included

- `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `agents/`: the podcast-tool-short skill (MIT, kubcode.dev).
- `helpers/yt-package/` and `helpers/yt-seo/`: title/thumbnail and
  description/tags skills by **Jake Schincariol**, under their own MIT licences
  (each folder's `LICENSE`).

## Not included

- **HyperFrames** (the renderer), **FFmpeg** and **whisper.cpp** (local
  transcription). Install them yourself; they have their own licences.
- Any podcast audio or video. The example clips on kubcode.dev use Jupiter
  Broadcasting episodes under CC BY-SA 4.0, credited on the page.

## Before you publish a clip

The source podcast's licence decides what you may do. Check it for every
episode, keep the credit and the licence link, and follow share-alike when the
source requires it. A download link is not a licence. See
`references/media-checks.md`.
